mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 is a lipophilic antioxidant that may reduce atovaquone absorption or bioavailability when taken concurrently, as both compete for intestinal absorption in the lipid-rich environment and CoQ10 may interfere with atovaquone's mitochondrial electron transport mechanism.
action: Separate administration by several hours and monitor clinical efficacy of atovaquone therapy; consider increased atovaquone dosing or more frequent monitoring for treatment failure in opportunistic infections.
